recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes should start from the current Composition.section.text and document presentation rules, not from the retired section.content/List model.
issue_request: FHIR-6917 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked to simplify DSTU1 Composition wording about narrative-only sections by using List.text as the section narrative holder. Its Jira comments state that the language was removed altogether per #7404.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-6917 or #6917 source commit was found. The applicable implementation is the related #7404 history: commits 686889f8a3b83c74a4e58ddddfac7616dd0da4ca and 749c4dd88234688f57191d3d0b4d62bdc525b87d refactored Composition away from section.content/List, introduced Composition.section.text and Composition.section.entry, updated document presentation prose, and removed the exact obsolete narrative-only section paragraph.
additional_context: FHIR-7103 raised the same wording request and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-7404 is also already represented and supplied the current Composition.section.text model. FHIR-7371 is related background showing the List narrative concern became redundant after Composition changes.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding the proposed List.text wording now would reintroduce an obsolete model; current combined source already says narrative-only sections use Composition.section.text with no Composition.section.entry and that List narrative is not attested document presentation unless incorporated into Composition narrative or section.text.
